cronjobs.name: ALYGN: Municipal Outreach Daily
cronjobs.description: Daily municipal outreach for Costa Rica cantons - PRODUCTION READY

payload.message:
Execute Municipal Outreach Pipeline for Costa Rica (PRODUCTION MODE):

STEP 1: Discovery
- Run: cd $HOME/.openclaw/workspace && node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/discovery/muni-discovery.js
- Loads 82 cantones from costa-rica-real-municipalities.json

STEP 2: Research
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/research/muni-research.js
- Finds mayor names/emails from pre-verified data
- Output: /tmp/muni-researched.json

STEP 3: Personalization
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/personalization/muni-personalizer.js --input=/tmp/muni-researched.json
- Generates Spanish emails using Grok
- Replaces ALL placeholders with regex /g flag
- Output: /tmp/muni-personalized.json

STEP 4: PREVIEW FOR APPROVAL
- Load /tmp/muni-personalized.json
- For each municipality, extract:
  * Municipality name
  * Mayor name
  * Subject line
  * First 200 chars of body (snippet)
  * Recipient email
- POST TO DISCORD #annotations with format:

📧 MUNICIPAL OUTREACH - AWAITING APPROVAL

**Municipality:** [name]
**Mayor:** [name]
**To:** [email]
**Subject:** [subject]
**Body Preview:**
[first 200 chars...]

Reply with:
- "approved" to send all
- "approved: [municipality name]" to send specific one
- "skip" to skip this batch
- "edit: [changes]" to request modifications

DO NOT SEND until explicit "approved" is received in reply.

STEP 5: SEND (ONLY AFTER APPROVAL)
- Wait for reply containing "approved"
- Once approved, run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/sending/email-sender-smtp-v2.js --input=/tmp/muni-personalized.json --limit=5
- Sends to actual municipal emails (production mode)
- Updates Notion status to 'Sent'

TEMPLATE PARAMETERS:
- recipientName: municipality.contacts.mayor_name
- municipality: municipality.name
- painPoints: municipality.pain_points.join(', ')
- subject: Generated by personalizer
- bodyHtml: Full personalized body (all placeholders replaced)
- bodyText: Auto-generated from HTML
- variant: 'governance' | 'institutional'
- footer: Template default
- useCid: false (base64 PNG logo)

SAFETY: This is PRODUCTION. Emails will go to REAL municipal contacts once approved.

cronjobs.name: ALYGN: VC Outreach Daily
cronjobs.description: Daily VC outreach for investor relations - PRODUCTION READY

payload.message:
Execute VC Outreach Pipeline (PRODUCTION MODE):

STEP 1: Load VCs from Notion
- Query database: 30b33487-4af6-8106-8cba-d304fdd0b600
- Filter: status = 'Ready for outreach'
- Limit: 5 VCs per run

STEP 2: Generate Drafts
- Run: cd $HOME/.openclaw/workspace && node scripts/alygn/vc-outreach/email/draft-outreach-emails.js --limit=5
- Generates 3 subject options per VC (A/B/C)
- Selects variant (governance|institutional) based on research
- Saves drafts to scripts/alygn/vc-outreach/drafts/

STEP 3: PREVIEW FOR APPROVAL
- Load generated drafts
- For each VC, extract:
  * VC name
  * Partner name
  * Subject options (A/B/C)
  * First 200 chars of body (snippet)
  * Recipient email
- POST TO DISCORD #annotations with format:

📧 VC OUTREACH - AWAITING APPROVAL

**VC:** [name]
**Partner:** [name]
**To:** [email]
**Subject Options:**
A) [subject A]
B) [subject B]
C) [subject C]
**Body Preview:**
[first 200 chars...]

Reply with:
- "approved" or "option A/B/C, approved" to send
- "approved: [VC name]" to send specific one
- "skip" to skip this batch
- "edit: [changes]" to request modifications

DO NOT SEND until explicit "approved" is received in reply.

STEP 4: SEND (ONLY AFTER APPROVAL)
- Wait for reply containing "approved"
- Once approved, run: node scripts/alygn/vc-outreach/email/send-approved-emails.js --limit=5
- Sends to actual VC emails (production mode)
- Updates Notion status to 'Sent'

TEMPLATE PARAMETERS:
- recipientName: partner first name
- companyName: vc.name
- painPoints: vc.painPoints.join(', ')
- subject: Selected from A/B/C options
- bodyHtml: Optional additional content
- bodyText: Auto-generated from HTML
- variant: 'governance' | 'institutional'
- footer: Template default
- useCid: false (base64 PNG logo)

SAFETY: This is PRODUCTION. Emails will go to REAL VC contacts once approved.
